title: Pan-STARRS discovers 'Oumuamua

tellings.quote: In 2017, the Pan-STARRS telescope in Hawaii discovered a fast-traveling object in space called Oumuamua.
In 2017, we discovered Amua Mua, the first ever interstellar object to visit our solar system.
tellings.difference: Leaves out Pan-STARRS and Hawaii, and calls it the first interstellar object ever seen in the solar system.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the 2017 discovery of 'Oumuamua as the first interstellar object.

plain: In 2017, the Pan-STARRS telescope in Hawaii spotted a fast-moving object passing through space, later named 'Oumuamua. Michels tells this himself in an episode with the Harvard researcher Avi Loeb, and in a later episode he calls it the first interstellar object ever seen visiting our solar system, citing Loeb. It matters because an object from outside our solar system is very rare, and some ask what it might be.
